hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a joint entry for Mongghul and Mangghuer under the ethnicity label Tu [mjg]. There is some sociocultural justification for this, but the two are not intelligible, so separate language entries are warranted on linguistic grounds
(**hh:g:Slater:Mangghuer**:3) See also: Mongghul [mjg].
